description: Text message notifications are not received by the target user in TruckConnect. Diagnose and fix server, client, and real-time delivery issues.

problems_identified.title: Server event not emitted
problems_identified.details: The backend route that sends messages may save to the DB but does not trigger the real-time notification event to the receiver.

problems_identified.title: Client subscription missing
problems_identified.details: The receiver may not be subscribed to the correct Ably/Sockets channel or event to listen for incoming messages.

problems_identified.title: Payload mismatch
problems_identified.details: The notification payload may be malformed or missing required fields like senderName, messageText, or conversationId.

problems_identified.title: Toast rendering issues
problems_identified.details: Frontend may not trigger Sonner toast correctly when a message event is received.

expected_behavior: When sender posts a message, receiver gets a real-time notification
Notification includes sender name, message text, and conversation ID
Toast pops up on receiver's UI immediately
Messages appear in conversation view in real-time

requirements: After storing message in DB, emit 'text_message_received' event to receiverId via Ably/Sockets
Include senderName, senderId, messageText, conversationId, timestamp in payload

tasks.description: Ensure client subscribes to correct channel/event
requirements: Subscribe to 'text_message_received' using receiverId or conversation channel
Use Ably/Sockets typed on() listener to handle incoming events
Use Sonner toast when 'text_message_received' is captured
Show sender name and preview of message text
Ensure toast appears even if conversation view is not currently open
Log message payload at server emit and client receive

steps: Send a text message from one account to another
Verify server emits 'text_message_received' with correct payload
Check client console logs for event reception
Confirm toast notification appears with correct info
Open conversation view and confirm message appears in real-time
